meta.self_assessment: Fixed src/middleware/user.js's registrationComplete: both the no-session-registration branch (which previously redirected unconfirmed non-admin users to /me/edit/email for every route, including /confirm/*) and the session-registration branch (which only exact-matched /register/complete, not /confirm/*) now share one 'exempt' check for paths ending in /edit/email or starting with /confirm/, and both redirect to /register/complete when not exempt; could not run the project's mocha+MongoDB suite in this sandboxed environment, so verification is by static/logical review of the middleware and its callers only, not by executing tests.

Confident: renamed CpeNameMatch to CpeVersionMatch, added CpeVendorProductMatch(10) selected via NvdJSON==nil in DetectCpeURIsCves, switched sort to numeric score, updated TUI to score/method, and full test suite passes.

Added Digest field to config.Image and models.Image, GetFullName() on config.Image, tightened IsValidImage to require exactly one of Tag/Digest with the exact specified error strings, propagated Digest through scan/base.go's model conversion, switched scan/container.go to GetFullName(), fixed scan/serverapi.go's per-image ServerName to <idx>@<originalServerName> with no tag/digest, and fixed report/report.go's UUID-key naming to use the full image ref (tag or digest, never both) followed by @serverName; go build and go test ./config/... ./scan/... ./report/... all pass (models/... test failure is a pre-existing go-vet incompatibility in untouched library.go, unrelated to this change).

Implemented all stated requirements (config.Image.Digest + GetFullName, three exact IsValidImage errors, models.Image.Digest, Digest propagation in scan/base.go, GetFullName for the scan domain and detection log, index@server naming in serverapi.go, full-reference@server in report.go); go build clean and all package tests pass except models.TestScan, which fails identically on the untouched base commit because it needs network.

Added User.hidePrivateData(userData, callerUID) in src/user/data.js (non-mutating copy; self/admin/global-mod bypass; email gated on showemail + meta.config.hideEmail, fullname on showfullname + meta.config.hideFullname, hidden as empty strings) and applied it in Users.get in src/controllers/write/users.js; mirrors the existing accounts/helpers.js semantics and passes 14 stubbed-dependency branch tests, but NodeBB's real suite needs a live database so it was not run here.
